visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male host with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a mauve t-shirt and silver necklace appears in the bottom of the frame against a white studio kitchen background. Above him, a square piece of moist chocolate cake sits on a black plate with a gold rim as a thick white milky liquid is poured around the base of the cake. (2) The visual cuts to close-up shots of hands using a wire whisk to mix dark chocolate batter, egg yolks, and light brown sugar in a glass bowl on a wooden countertop. The host continues to speak in a small inset at the bottom. A hand is seen sliding a baking tray into a modern silver oven. (3) The scene focuses on a large silver and white bag of UCC Iced Espresso Latte coffee. A single packet is shown, then the brown coffee powder is poured into a white dairy liquid in a plastic bowl and whisked into a beige mixture. (4) The host demonstrates the next step: pouring the beige coffee-milk mixture over a large chocolate cake in a parchment-lined tray. A hand then spreads a thick layer of light-colored whipped coffee cream over the cake using a large metal offset spatula until the surface is smooth. (5) Dark brown cocoa powder is sifted over the cream layer, followed by a close-up of a fork lifting a slice of the layered cake to reveal its texture. The host then eats a piece of the cake from a small plate, expressing delight with wide eyes and a smile. (6) The host demonstrates preparing the coffee as a drink by stirring powder into a glass of water with a metal spoon. He holds up multiple UCC coffee product bags and a large red-and-yellow promotional gift box featuring traditional decorative patterns toward the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Tutorial -> Tasting -> Product Feature Highlight -> Call-to-Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative product promotion for UCC Iced Espresso Latte and Iced Salted Caramel Latte. It leverages a trendy 'Three-Milk Cake' (Tres Leches) recipe to demonstrate the product's versatility as an ingredient in baking and as a convenient, cold-soluble drink. The high-energy narration and professional visual editing aim to attract dessert lovers and coffee enthusiasts, concluding with a specific sales call for the 'Ghost Festival' (Zhongyuan) limited edition packaging.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The host explicitly names the brand UCC, shows clear close-ups of product packaging, demonstrates product use, and provides a direct call-to-action to purchase the items.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully combines 'food porn' visuals of a popular dessert with a high-energy influencer-style pitch. The use of cold-soluble coffee as a key ingredient provides a practical reason for the consumer to buy the product.
